name: acorn-workspace
description: Acorn is software that helps people create the future

scripts.desktop:ui: KANGAROO=true WEB_PORT=8081 ADMIN_WS_PORT=1101 APP_WS_PORT=8101 yarn workspace acorn-ui dev
scripts.moss:ui: WEB_PORT=8081 ADMIN_WS_PORT=1101 APP_WS_PORT=8101 yarn workspace acorn-ui dev
scripts.web2: WEB_PORT=8082 ADMIN_WS_PORT=1102 APP_WS_PORT=8102 yarn workspace acorn-ui dev
scripts.web3: WEB_PORT=8083 ADMIN_WS_PORT=1103 APP_WS_PORT=8103 yarn workspace acorn-ui dev
scripts.web4: WEB_PORT=8084 ADMIN_WS_PORT=1104 APP_WS_PORT=8104 yarn workspace acorn-ui dev
scripts.build:zomes: RUSTFLAGS='--cfg getrandom_backend="custom"' cargo build --release --target-dir happs/target --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --manifest-path happs/Cargo.toml
scripts.pack:happ: hc dna pack --output=happs/happ/workdir/projects.dna happs/happ/workdir/dna/projects && hc app pack --output=happs/happ/workdir/acorn.happ happs/happ/workdir
scripts.build:happ:release: yarn build:zomes && yarn optimize:zomes && yarn pack:happ
scripts.package: rm -f web/dist.zip web/dist/*.js web/dist/*.js.map && yarn workspace acorn-ui build && yarn zip-ui && hc web-app pack --output=happs/happ/workdir/acorn.webhapp happs/happ/workdir && yarn weave-hash
scripts.release:webhapp: APP_VER=$(node -p "require('./web/package.json').version") && git tag v$APP_VER && git push origin v$APP_VER

author: Connor Turland <connor@sprillow.com>
